item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 21/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to bring fine and dry weather to the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large over the region. Replenishments of the monsoon will persist over Guangdong early to midweek next week. The weather will remain cool in the morning and at night over the coastal areas. Meanwhile, an area of low pressure is expected to move across the southern part of the South China Sea. The associated band of clouds will cover the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong. Another surge of the northeast monsoon will affect southern China in the latter part of next week.
